verdict.rationale: Vercel documents several official SDKs: an SDK for its REST API, the AI SDK for calling models through AI Gateway, the Workflow SDK for durable agents, the Flags SDK, and JS/Python SDK references for Blob. A live OpenAPI description backs the API surface. Each SDK appears only in brief one-line mentions, with no depth on SDK reference docs, installation, language coverage or versioning. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation, documented language coverage for the REST API SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
Call hundreds of models through one endpoint with the AI SDK, any OpenAI-compatible SDK, or cURL
Build durable, observable applications and AI agents with the Workflow SDK on a fully managed platform.
Run experiments on static pages with Statsig and the Flags SDK.
The docs nav includes dedicated 'Server Uploads' and 'Client Uploads' pages and JS/Python SDK references
